info.name: Steam Wishlist Fix
info.description: For people that have hundreds of games on their Steam Wishlist and want to organize them or prioritize certain items. Normally Control+F doesn't work and when you use the wishlist search feature you can't change the ranking/priority of the game/item. Setting this up retains the little drag/reorder/send to top sidebar even if you have a filter active, and lets you move filtered items around. Hope this helps someone else!
